# Item Bridge

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing)

<a href="Item-item-bridge.md" title="Item Bridge"><img src="icons/190.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Item Bridge"></a>

A Floater Rock bridge joining two distant item pipe networks.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Placement | Place from the hotbar |

## How to obtain

Craft a pair at the Machinist’s Bench; see the recipe below.

## Using it

Connect matching pipes/cables, then give both bridges the same private network name. Both chunks must be loaded. See [Bridges and chunk loaders](Bridges-and-chunk-loaders.md).
